BUY-SELL AGREEMENT

This Buy-Sell Agreement is among Corbin Hardware, Inc. (the "Company") and its shareholders, Lee Corbin and Ana Ruiz.

1. Restriction. No shareholder may transfer shares except as this Agreement allows.

2. Death. On the death of a shareholder, the Company will purchase, and the estate will sell, all of the shares of the deceased shareholder.

3. Price. The purchase price is the value the shareholders agree on each year in a signed certificate, or if none was signed in the last two years, the value set by an appraiser.

4. Funding. The Company will keep life insurance on each shareholder to fund the purchase.
